sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the difference between Moshe's "Arise, Hashem" and Dovid's "Arise, Hashem" in terms of the manner of refinement and the persistence of opposition.

translations.translation: And it may be said,
that the difference between "Arise, Hashem" said by Moshe and "Arise, Hashem" said by Dovid is in two matters.
The manner of refinement
[that the refinement through the Ark of the Mishkan was in a manner of war,
therefore it is said "Let Your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate You flee,"
for there are opponents
(Your enemies and those who hate You)
that one must fight against them,
and the refinement in the days of Shlomo, and particularly through the revelation of the Beis HaMikdash, was in a manner of rest,
"Arise, Hashem, to Your resting place,"
as explained above at length],
and also in the refinement itself.
For this that in "Arise, Hashem" said by Moshe it is stated "Let Your enemies be scattered and let those who hate You flee,"
is,
because even after the refinement through the journeying of the Ark in the desert,
there still remained opponents,
Your enemies and those who hate You,
except that they were in a manner of "they will be scattered and they will flee."
And the explanation is,
that in refinement that is in a manner from above to below,
where the upper
(the refiner)
does not become invested in the lower, and the refinement of the lower is through the revelation of the light of the upper,
this that the lower is not opposed is not from its own existence
(will,
intellect, etc.)
but rather, on the contrary,
because through the revelation of a light that is not commensurate with it shining upon it, it becomes nullified from its existence55.
And behold, when the refinement is in a manner that the upper
(the refiner)
comes into the place of the lower
(the one being refined),
this proves that the lower occupies a place relative to it,
and therefore it is not possible that through its revelation the lower will be nullified completely.
And since this refinement is also in a manner from above to below and not in a manner of investment
(as above in section 8),
and the nullification through the revelation of this light is not a complete nullification,
therefore,
even after the refinement there still remains
(in concealment)
the existence of the opponent
(Your enemies and those who hate You),
but nevertheless,
since the lower is not commensurate even relative to this revelation that has a grasp of place relative to it,
therefore,
even through this revelation the force of the lower is nullified,
and its opposition
(Your enemies and those who hate You)
is in a manner of "they will be scattered and they will flee."
However, in the refinement that is in a manner of rest,
this that the upper
(the refiner)
is in its place and does not descend to the place of the lower is because the lower does not occupy a place relative to it – through the revelation of this light,
the nullification of the lower is a complete nullification.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that even when the refiner remains in its place, if the lower has a grasp of place relative to it, the nullification is not complete, and true rest requires the revelation of Atik, which is above connection to worlds.

translations.translation: And it may be said with greater depth,
that even when the refinement is in a manner that the refiner is in its place, but it is on such a level that the one being refined has a grasp of place relative to it,
the nullification of the opponent is not a complete nullification.
And based on this, there is additional explanation in this that is implied in the maamar, that this that Shlomo was a man of rest is because in his days the moon stood in its fullness,
wealth that is above the filling of lack,
for the true concept of rest
[and peace]56
is when the opponent is nullified completely,
and in order for the opponent to be nullified completely it is through the drawing down of the concept of wealth,
Ein Sof that is above connection to worlds,
Atik.
For in light that is related to worlds,
including even the surrounding light,
Kesser,
since this light gives place to worlds,
world (olam) from the term concealment and hiding57
– the nullification of the opponents in the world through the revelation of this light is not a complete nullification.
And this that Shlomo was a man of rest and there was peace in his days is because in his days there was the drawing down of the aspect of Atik,
wealth.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section discusses the revelation of chesed above wealth, which will be in the future, drawing from the Essence of Atik, the Ein Sof in Arich Anpin, and explains that Shlomo's wealth was a revelation of the levels of light, not the Essence itself.

translations.translation: And 4)
And the maamar continues,
that the concept of chesed which is above even wealth
[therefore acts of kindness are also for the wealthy],
is the revelation of the future that is more elevated even than the revelation that was in the days of Shlomo.
For the drawing down in the days of Shlomo was from the aspect of Atik
(as above),
and in the future the drawing down will be from the aspect of the innerness of Atik,
namely the Ein Sof that is in Arich Anpin,
which is the essential concept of Atik.
And to note from what is said in the Zohar
(in Idra Zuta58)
"This Atika is found in three heads,"
and the Ari z"l explained
(in the explanation of Idra Zuta59),
that the essence of Atika is the Ein Sof,
and because of its concealment in the three heads, the three heads are also called by the name Atik.
And based on this, the essence of Atika is the Ein Sof that is in all three heads.
But in this maamar it explains that the essential concept of Atik is the Ein Sof that is in Arich Anpin.
And this may be explained based on what is said in the maamar
(in the continuation of the topic)
regarding the matter of what the Ari z"l said
(in the explanation of Idra Zuta there)
"He is found and concealed and revealed in three heads,"
that the three expressions "found and concealed and revealed" are like the three concepts of "Atah Hu V'Hayah."
"Found" is like "Atah,"
Essence,
"concealed and revealed" are like "Hu" and "V'Hayah,"
two levels in light.
And the explanation of "found" is that He is found as He is in His Essence.
And based on this, it may be explained what is said in the maamar that the essential concept of Atik is the Ein Sof that is in Arich Anpin.
And to add,
that according to the explanation in the maamar of the concept of "found"
(that Ein Sof is found in Arich Anpin)
is that He is found in Arich Anpin as He is in His Essence,
it may be explained that in the days of Shlomo there was true wealth,
even though there was not then the revelation of the future,
for the innovation that will be in the future is that then there will be the revelation of the Essence that is above the aspect of revelations,
and the concept of revelations was in the days of Shlomo in perfection.
